text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mozambican President Joaquim Chissano said in an interview he hopes the opposition Renamo party will take part in municipal elections scheduled for November. He was reacting to a Renamo warning that it might boycott the elections.

- Prime Minister Pascoal Mocumbi said foreign tourists are being overcharged in Mozambique and called for better terms for visitors. He was speaking at the inauguration of international customs and immigration services at the airport in the holiday town of Vilankulo in the southern province of Inhambane.
